name: roprobe
description: A tool and extension for inspecting Roblox games.

roprobe.broker.host.markdownDescription: Host the extension talks to the broker on. A loopback host (`127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, `::1`) lets the extension spawn and manage a local broker; anything else attaches to a broker someone else is running, and needs `#roprobe.broker.port#` and `#roprobe.broker.token#` set to match it.

roprobe.broker.port.markdownDescription: Port the broker listens on. `0` lets it pick a free port on startup; pin one to keep the port stable across restarts. Required when `#roprobe.broker.host#` is remote.

roprobe.broker.token.markdownDescription: Auth token the broker accepts. Empty mints a fresh one per broker startup, which the extension reads back from the local broker's lockfile. Required when `#roprobe.broker.host#` is remote.

roprobe.broker.path.markdownDescription: Broker executable to run instead of the bundled one. Only used when the extension spawns the broker itself.

roprobe.upstream.verde.markdownDescription: Whether the broker bridges to verde. Re-applied on every connection, so it also governs a broker the extension did not spawn.

roprobe.upstream.verdePort.markdownDescription: Port of verde's WebSocket server. The broker reads this once at startup, so it only takes effect on a broker the extension spawns.

roprobe.securityLevel.markdownDescription: Highest property write-security tier the inspector shows; raise it to expose Roblox-internal properties. Applied to each session as it connects.

roprobe.output.autoReveal.markdownDescription: Reveal the Output panel when the session whose console output is redirected changes.

scripts.compile: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: pnpm run compile-tests && pnpm run compile && pnpm run lint
